starter_questions: How can I try the included simulated transfer?
What should my Markdown procedure include?
Why did the last procedure adapt or stop?

setup_guide.introduction: I'll turn your Markdown lab procedure into a PyLabRobot simulation, watch the tracked deck after each step and explain any adjustment. Start with the included synthetic transfer, then provide your own procedure. This co-worker operates simulated liquid handling only.

sample.title: Synthetic transfer with an alternate source
sample.description: The primary source has too little liquid. Observe a bounded switch to an explicitly allowed well with the same simulated liquid.
sample.expected_output: A live deck, a transfer decision, final volume checks and a saved replay.

real.introduction: Supply your own Markdown procedure for simulation. Physical lab equipment is outside this blueprint.

fields.label: Lab procedure
fields.description: Paste Markdown with explicit starting volumes, numbered steps and final goals. Clear the procedure file when using text.

fields.label: Procedure file
fields.description: Select a .md file instead of pasting text.

fields.label: Saved explanation preferences
fields.description: Managed in Memory. Changes Chat wording; revise the Markdown and start a new run to change the procedure.

web_ui.title: Web lab
web_ui.description: Live PyLabRobot deck during simulation, followed by a saved run replay.
